propositions: The enrich drain gate's pending_enrichment check is O(ticket_count), issuing ~24,000 filesystem metadata syscalls per write on a 4,800+ ticket store, causing 486-740 ms latency against a declared 20 ms budget.

The gate runs opportunistically on every write when verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets is enabled, making the budget breach 100% observable and rendering the warning signal useless for detecting genuine future problems.

Under concurrent agent load, gate checks contend on kernel vnode cache saturation rather than CPU, producing nonlinear latency spikes (2.4-6.3x slowdown with multiple concurrent walkers) on write-path critical path.
An O(1) marker file under .rebar tracking next_eligible_ns can short-circuit the full store walk when no entries are soaked, degrading gracefully to full scan on marker absence or corruption.
